# Azure Compute Capacity
Latest deployed vCPU inventory across the management-group scope. Capacity views aggregate deployed vCPUs by subscription and VM family because Azure Compute quota is enforced at the family level.

parameters.name: Subscription
parameters.label: Subscription
parameters.query: resourcecontainers | where type =~ 'microsoft.resources/subscriptions' | project value=subscriptionId, label=name | order by label asc

parameters.name: Region
parameters.label: Region
parameters.query: let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s); ComputeCapacity_CL | where CollectionId_s == latestCollection | extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey | distinct Region_s | order by Region_s asc | project value=Region_s, label=Region_s

parameters.name: Family
parameters.label: VM Family
parameters.query: let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s); ComputeCapacity_CL | where CollectionId_s == latestCollection | extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey | where isnotempty(VmFamily_s) | distinct VmFamily_s | order by VmFamily_s asc | project value=VmFamily_s, label=VmFamily_s

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
let capacity = ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey;
let scoped = capacity
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family});
let totalInstances = toscalar(scoped | summarize sum(tolong(DeployedInstances_d)));
scoped
| summarize ['VM instances']=sum(tolong(DeployedInstances_d)) by Subscription=SubscriptionName_s, Region=Region_s
| extend ['Deployment share']=iff(totalInstances > 0, todouble(['VM instances']) / totalInstances, 0.0)
| order by ['Deployment share'] desc, Subscription asc, Region asc
content.title: Deployment concentration heat map - percentage of VM instances by subscription and region
content.noDataMessage: No deployed compute was found for the selected subscriptions and regions.

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
let capacity = ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey;
let scoped = capacity
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family});
union
(scoped | summarize Value=sum(tolong(DeployedVCpus_d)) by SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, Region_s | extend RegionalMetric=strcat(Region_s, ' - Deployed vCPUs')),
(scoped | summarize Value=take_any(tolong(QuotaLimitVCpus_d)) by SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, Region_s | extend RegionalMetric=strcat(Region_s, ' - VM-family quota')),
(scoped | summarize Value=take_any(tolong(QuotaAvailableVCpus_d)) by SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, Region_s | extend RegionalMetric=strcat(Region_s, ' - Available quota gap'))
| project SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s, RegionalMetric, Value
| evaluate pivot(RegionalMetric, take_any(Value), SubscriptionName_s, VmFamily_s)
| order by SubscriptionName_s asc, VmFamily_s asc
content.title: VM family by region matrix - deployed vCPUs, quota, and available gap

content.query:
let latestCollection = toscalar(ComputeCapacityRuns_CL | where Status_s == 'Completed' | top 1 by CompletedAt_t desc | project CollectionId_s);
ComputeCapacity_CL
| where CollectionId_s == latestCollection
| extend DedupKey=iff(isempty(RecordId_s), strcat(SubscriptionId_s, '|', Region_s, '|', ComputeSku_s), RecordId_s)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DedupKey
| where '*' in ({Subscription}) or SubscriptionId_s in ({Subscription})
| where '*' in ({Region}) or Region_s in ({Region})
| where '*' in ({Family}) or VmFamily_s in ({Family})
| summarize ['Deployed vCPUs']=sum(tolong(DeployedVCpus_d)), ['Reserved vCPUs']=take_any(tolong(ReservedVCpus_d)), ['Regional quota']=take_any(tolong(QuotaLimitVCpus_d)), ['Quota used']=take_any(tolong(QuotaUsageVCpus_d)), ['Quota available']=take_any(tolong(QuotaAvailableVCpus_d)) by Subscription=SubscriptionName_s, Region=Region_s, Family=VmFamily_s
| extend ['Quota utilization']=iff(['Regional quota'] > 0, todouble(['Deployed vCPUs']) / ['Regional quota'], real(null))
| project Subscription, Region, Family, ['Deployed vCPUs'], ['Reserved vCPUs'], ['Regional quota'], ['Quota utilization'], ['Quota used'], ['Quota available']
| order by Subscription asc, Region asc, Family asc
content.title: Regional detail
